prerequisite_milestone.name: Reviewed training data and generation rules
acceptance: Stable exercise identifiers, bilingual names and cues, reviewed age applicability, movement patterns, equipment, dosage fields, substitution links and media provenance.
Reviewed starter templates and bounded generation/progression/recovery rules, with explicit rationale and provenance.
Example plans for adults and teens, bodyweight and equipment, Light/Medium/Hard and stop/recovery cases.
Clear separation of research evidence, product defaults, and exercise-professional review still required; a draft dataset is not clinical validation.
User approval of the data shape before deeper window work; no background or sprite generation during this planning task.

approval_workflow.name: Flow/data approval
approval_workflow.requirement: Approve the purpose, step-by-step flow, data, exact EN/ES copy, states and orientation together with retained versioned EN/ES rendered proposal previews. Record exact image hashes and sample fixture. This sets the visual target; subsequent production asset approvals remain separate.

approval_workflow.name: Background alone approval
approval_workflow.requirement: Generate only the window background, without characters, UI, icons, or text. Stop and obtain approval. For an existing background, present the exact asset and obtain reuse approval.

approval_workflow.name: Environment props/foreground approval
approval_workflow.requirement: Generate only the approved next props/foreground batch with placement/occlusion notes. Stop and obtain approval; explicitly approve reuse or record N/A when there are no such assets.

approval_workflow.name: Character/enemy/gear sprites approved
approval_workflow.requirement: Complete G3a base → G3b customization → G3c wearable equipment → G3d motion/export as separate serial approvals. Generate only the smallest batch needed for each subgate, then stop. Approve exact reuse or record N/A explicitly; no combined sprite-batch approval bypasses these subgates.

subgates.name: Base character or enemy
subgates.requirement: Approve the base proportions, views, neutral clothing and reference sheet before customization. Record exact reuse approval or N/A when applicable.

subgates.name: Customization
subgates.requirement: Approve skin treatment, hair, supported body/muscle variants and headgear compatibility before wearable equipment. Record exact reuse approval or N/A when applicable.

subgates.name: Wearable equipment
subgates.requirement: Approve item concepts, slots, fits, masks, attachments and equipped samples before animation/export. Record exact reuse approval or N/A when applicable.

subgates.name: Motion and sprite/export proof
subgates.requirement: Approve the necessary motion, layering, fit and export proof before UI components. Record exact reuse approval or N/A when applicable.

approval_workflow.name: UI frame/icon/control assets approved
approval_workflow.requirement: Generate or design the required frame, icons and controls as separate assets. Keep functional EN/ES text editable in the eventual interface. Stop and obtain approval; explicitly approve shared-asset reuse or record N/A.

approval_workflow.name: Composite bilingual screen approval
approval_workflow.requirement: Assemble the individually approved production assets and editable EN/ES text into complete window/state renders. Compare against the approved proposal at its recorded baseline. Correct differences or obtain explicit approval of a revised reference; never silently replace the proposal. Approve the exact final composite before implementation.

approval_workflow.name: Implementation + visual verification
approval_workflow.requirement: Only after G5 approval, implement this window using its accepted data and assets, verify the user flow, and compare actual output with the accepted renders. Resolve discrepancies and obtain milestone acceptance before beginning the next window.

approval_rules: Current user-authorized workflow: approve each retained bilingual window proposal, assemble the complete native window using reference mapping and shared assets, then perform focused whole-screen visual and interaction checks. Do not create per-button render/test loops. WIN-001 appearance is accepted; WIN-002 is the only active proposal and is not yet approved.
The accepted overall style does not approve any individual background, sprite, prop, gear item, frame, or composed window.
Except for an explicitly recorded user override, every window inherits G0 through G6 in that exact order. No later gate starts while the previous gate lacks user approval.
Reuse requires an explicit recorded approval of the exact asset; regeneration is not the default. Record N/A with a reason when a stage has no applicable asset.
An approval log must capture window ID, gate, asset IDs and versions, user decision, date, and any requested corrections.
Do not batch-generate all backgrounds or all sprites across windows. Finish the current window milestone before starting another, unless the user explicitly changes the sequence.
Data dependencies can use clearly labeled fixtures during G0–G5. G6 must resolve necessary approved navigation and data contracts; dependencies do not authorize premature implementation.
G3 is a parent gate with four required serial subgates G3a–G3d. Asset document stages 3–6 are those same approvals, not a parallel or alternate workflow.

proposed_sequence.then: Approve the character/gear feasibility specification; a minimal representative sprite sample follows the first applicable G1/G2 approvals and must pass G3 before a full sprite batch.
proposed_sequence.note: The System Home preview is implemented in Unity 6000.3.24f1 and its Android installation/appearance are accepted by the user. WIN-002 native Welcome/email entry and Android integration are built. Firebase email is enabled/configured locally; Google is disabled pending public-support-contact permission. Final configured Android and Linux builds passed; physical-device verification remains pending. Home remains fictional sample data; signup, recovery and onboarding are future windows.
proposed_sequence.next_activity_after_M0: WIN-002 target is approved. Review the configured native result on a physical device. Google permission/OAuth configuration and real-device provider checks remain open; source-target approval is not native or authentication acceptance. The modular avatar pipeline remains a later deliverable.
